status: comparison_only - the canonical contract in results/unsw_nb15_current.json is still the attention run
question: todo.md Step 4 injects the semantic judgement as a bias on GATv2's attention logits. That mechanism is inert (churn 0.0000). Does delivering the same advice to the EDGE FEATURES make it live without breaking the ladder?
verdict: YES. Churn 0.0000 -> 0.0251, both advice controls fail, and the ladder still holds. Loop rung costs 0.0061 against the canonical 3-seed mean, inside the +/-0.014 seed spread.

head_sensitivity_flip_rate.note: Fraction of predictions that change when one input is perturbed by Gaussian noise at N% of its std. Measured on the trained UNSW GNN, forward passes only.
head_sensitivity_flip_rate.reading: At small perturbations the classifier head is ~84x more sensitive to edge features than to node embeddings. Attention can only speak through node embeddings.

co_location.note: 656 edges over 311 distinct (src,dst) pairs, max 10 edges on one pair. For co-located edges the four node-derived terms of the edge representation are identical, so only edge_attr separates them. Every consulted edge is co-located.

node_embedding_ablation.note: Both inputs carry real signal; the graph is NOT decorative. The attention path fails on addressing, not on the GNN being useless.

attention_only_via_edge_features.note: Advice routed into edge_attr but ONLY where it feeds the attention computation, leaving the classification representation untouched. This is Step 4's sentence word for word, on the live channel.
attention_only_via_edge_features.reading: Inert at every scale, and shuffled advice does NOT degrade it - nothing reaches the decision. Confirms the bottleneck is that attention's only output is node embeddings, not how the advice enters attention.

mechanism_only.protocol: use_output_fusion=False, so the LLM reaches the GNN ONLY through the feedback mechanism. NOT comparable to ladder numbers.

control_shuffled_advice.definition: REAL advice, permuted across edges - wrong edge, real distribution

control_noise_advice.definition: uniform noise replacing the advice distribution

mechanism_only.reading: edge+trained_head beats the no-feedback control by +0.0264 with non-overlapping seeds. Both advice controls fall BELOW the control, so the gain is semantic content, not added capacity. Neither factor works alone: edge+prototype +0.0028, attention+head +0.0006.

ladder_fusion_on.reading: GNN 0.5496 < LLM 0.7353 < AGAF 0.7459 < Loop 0.7610. Ladder holds with a live mechanism.

top_k_reselection.protocol: selected on validation folds only, edge injection live, fusion on, seed 42
top_k_reselection.reading: Unchanged from the canonical value. The live mechanism does not move the optimum, and churn is non-zero (0.021-0.037) at every setting.

iteration_cap.reading: Keep 3. More iterations do not help and actual iterations plateau near 3.1.

oracle_headroom.question: Can any fusion of the GNN and the trained LLM head beat the head alone (0.8321)?
oracle_headroom.verdict: NO. The exploitable pool is 9 of 656 edges (1.4%). A perfect label-aware router reaches only 0.8526, and realistic confidence routing scores 0.8017 - BELOW the head alone. No fusion change (no-regret floor, wider gate, top_k) can lift the loop past 0.8321; the binding constraint is the GNN rung.

configuration.bias_dim_note: must equal edge_attr_dim; enforced in FeedbackLoopClassifier.__init__

limitations: The loop rung here (0.7610 +/- 0.0144) is a 3-seed mean; results/unsw_nb15_current.json reports a single-seed point estimate (0.7764). The canonical config's own 3-seed mean is 0.7672 +/- 0.0123, so the two configurations differ by 0.0061 - inside the seed spread.

Edge injection deviates from todo.md Step 4's wording ('injected back into the GAT as an attention bias'). Two literal implementations were measured inert at up to 100x strength; see why_attention_is_inert.
Churn 0.0251 is ~16 edges of 656. The mechanism is live and reproducible across seeds, but modest.
The loop-over-AGAF gap (+0.0151) is inside the seed spread, so the top rung remains an observed ordering, not a significant one. Same caveat as the canonical contract.
KG discretisation bins are fit globally across all edges including test rows (rank-based, no labels). Mild transductive leakage, disclosed not fixed.
ToN-IoT has NOT been run with edge injection. The default remains injection_mode='attention' so the cross-dataset architecture contract still holds.
